title: commitwork per-term acceptances for release candidates
description: monitor/release-term-acceptances.json in the private sidecar: the reviewed disposition of each denied-term occurrence. Applied by applyAcceptances() in bin/lib/release-terms.mjs, read from the sidecar's committed tree so an uncommitted row cannot clear the gate. A row is keyed by file, rule, term and where — never by a line number — and is bound to the `evidence` digest of the one measurement it was granted against, so a new occurrence of an accepted term lapses the acceptance instead of inheriting it. An absent record is the public shape: nothing accepted, so every occurrence stays open. monitor/release-term-acceptances.example.json shows the shape.
